review.notes: No code fences exist in the OCR markdown; the heading tree matches the printed section structure with no spurious headings. Automated per-page droppage scan of all 15 physical pages (normalized 5-word window containment) triaged every flag: p.1 flags are broken-encoding figure text and the arXiv margin stamp; pp.11-13 flags are text inside the embedded Figure 3/5 images and the Figure 4 table, all present. Real defects: the p.4 Chimera footnote body was dropped (marker survives) and two benchmark tables had structural damage. Table 2 (p.8) was rebuilt by OCR on a 12-column grid whose sub-header spans (3/3/5) did not match the body triples, so every data cell straddled two labels; fixed by re-aligning the three FLORES-200 sub-headers to the uniform body grid (verified uniform across all 31 body rows). Table 4 (p.10) header groups were actually consistent, but each of the 18 Multi-IF data cells was split into three cells; merged back to the printed single 'turn1 / turn2 / turn3' cell and reduced the Multi-IF header to one column. Pages 4, 8, 10, 11 and 12 were rendered and visually read; the doubled-sentence and 'Chimera^1. Teacher' quirks are printed by the PDF itself. Remaining pages passed the machine scan only.
